page.title: Groups
page.description: Share costs with the people you spend with, see who owes whom and settle up.

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.description: Create a group for a trip, a shared flat or a dinner club, then split transactions with it.

your-balance.not-in-group: You are not in this group

create.title: New group
create.description: Name it, pick its currency and add the people who share costs with you.
create.name: Name
create.currency-hint: New settlements use it. Each shared expense keeps its own transaction's currency.
create.people-hint: You are in the group already. Add the others.
create.email-hint: Only for your own reference: WonderMoney never writes to it.

detail.remove-description: They leave the group. Someone with shared expenses or settlements cannot be removed.
detail.archived-notice: This group is archived: it is no longer offered when you split a transaction.
detail.delete-description: The group and its people are removed. This cannot be undone.
detail.not-empty-title: This group has shared expenses or settlements
detail.not-empty-description: Only an empty group can be deleted. Archive it instead: its history stays, and it is no longer offered when you split a transaction.
detail.not-found: This group does not exist or was deleted.

expenses.title: Shared expenses
expenses.empty: No shared expenses yet. Open a transaction and choose Split with group.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.linked-hidden: Linked to a transaction you cannot see

settlement.title: Record settlement
settlement.description: Someone paid someone back. The balances update as soon as you record it.
settlement.amount-invalid: Enter an amount above zero, with at most four decimals.
settlement.date-required: Pick the day the money changed hands.
settlement.link-hint: The money that moved. A linked transaction stops counting as income or spending.

share.title: Shared expense
share.hint: Share this cost with a group: each person's share becomes a line of its split, and only your household's shares count in your spending.
share.no-groups: You have no active groups yet.
share.blocked-transfer: A transfer between your own accounts cannot be shared.
share.blocked-loan-repayment: A loan repayment cannot be shared.
share.blocked-reimbursement: A transaction linked as a reimbursement cannot be shared.
share.category-hint: Every share goes in this category. Leave it to keep the current one.
share.zero-share: The amount is too small to share between this many people.
share.line-errors-amounts: Every person needs an amount above zero.
share.line-errors-percentages: Every person needs a percentage above zero, with at most two decimals.
share.replaces-split: Its current split is replaced by the shares.
share.stop-description: It is whole again, in one category, and leaves the group's balances.
share.split-locked: Shared in a group: change its shares with Edit shares below.
share.badge-label: Shared in a group: open the group

errors.load: This could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.save: This could not be saved. Try again.
errors.not-found: It was not found. It may have been deleted, or be on another member's private account.
errors.shares-invalid: The shares do not add up. Check each person's amount or percentage.
errors.transaction-conflict: This transaction already plays another part: a transfer, a loan repayment, a reimbursement, a settlement, or shared in another group.
errors.transaction-in-group: This transaction is shared in a group: change its shares in the group.
errors.settlement-invalid: That settlement does not fit: two different people, and a linked transaction must move money between your household and someone outside it.
errors.currency-mismatch: The linked transaction is in another currency than the settlement.
errors.amount-exceeded: That is more than what is left to link on the transaction.
errors.member-invalid: That person cannot be added: they are not in your household, or are in the group already.
errors.member-in-use: This person has shared expenses or settlements in the group, so they cannot be removed.
errors.not-empty: This group has shared expenses or settlements, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.account-read-only: You can view this transaction's account but not change it.
